fields.statement: Run 01M6K32A hung because its fixer session's record has a SessionEnd hook ('done') but no exit report (the wrapper died in the reboot) and its Rex block is gone. When should a run check an in-flight session for having ended unseen? / How is a session found ended unseen judged? / If Rex cannot be reached on rejoin (not a 'not found' answer), what happens?
